 St. Augustine’s Nights of Lights up for Best Public Holiday Lights Display in the country
 WJAX Follow Amanda Winkle Tue, November 17, 2026 at 11:08 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Tue, November 17, 2026 at 11:08 PM UTC Starts Nov. 15 in St. Augustine Credit: Visit St. Augustine St. Augustine's annual holiday lights display is getting (more) national recognition (again).
 Nights of Lights is one of 20 nominees up for USA TODAY's 10Best Public Holiday Lights Display .
 >>> STREAM ACTION NEWS JAX LIVE <<< 
 Nights of Lights has made the 10Best list in this category in 2014, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
 Millions of lights adorn every corner of St. Augustine's historic district for two months.
 [DOWNLOAD: Free Action News Jax app for alerts as news breaks ] 
 The award-winning holiday lights display runs this holiday season from Saturday, Nov. 21 through Monday, Jan. 18 in historic St. Augustine.
